thread:
Ava: Hey — small PR that moves files from tools/daemon -> runtime/daemon and updates imports/build paths. Who should approve this? CODEOWNERS currently maps /tools/ -> @Devon and /runtime/ -> @Sam. Do we need both? cc @Devon @Sam :thinking_face:

Devon: If it's a straight move, new owners (runtime) are the primary reviewers. But it touches CI paths in .github/workflows/build.yaml from the diff you mentioned earlier, so that brings in the workflows owner. What's the PR number?

Ava: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/7890. It's a move + update to the build workflow to include the new path. No logic changes besides import paths.

Sam: I can handle the runtime code review. If the workflow file is updated we should get @Ali to review that. If CI changes are trivial, one workflow review + runtime review should be enough.

Ava: Thanks. Here's the current CODEOWNERS snippet from the repo head:
```
/tools/ @Devon
/runtime/ @Sam
.github/workflows/ @Ali
```

Devon: Given that, I think we need Sam + Ali to sign off. Note: GitHub CODEOWNERS enforcement sometimes requires the owner of the old path to approve if the move is part of the same PR. You can either add me as a reviewer to be safe or update CODEOWNERS in the PR to add the new glob.

Ali: I can approve the workflow change. FYI — adding the CODEOWNERS change in the same PR is the cleanest: once merged the destination owners exist. Until then GitHub might still request the original owner for the moved files. If you want to avoid that, add @Devon as a reviewer and ask for a quick sanity check.

Ava: Quick questions: 1) If I update CODEOWNERS in this PR to include `/runtime/daemon/* @Sam`, will GitHub retroactively clear the old owner requirement? 2) Who has merge rights for this repo right now?

Sam: 1) Adding the CODEOWNERS change in the PR usually works — once the CODEOWNERS file is in the merge commit, the new owner mapping takes effect. But while the PR is open GitHub might still block based on the pre-change rules. 2) Repo protection requires 2 approvals (one must be a CODEOWNER). People with merge perms: me, Devon, and engineering leads. If you get Sam + Ali (or Sam + Devon) approvals you should be able to merge.

Devon: I'll give it a quick review. If it's literally just file move + updated imports and a workflow path tweak, I can give a fast :+1:. If you want to speed it up, add the CODEOWNERS change and ping me.

CodeownerBot: CI checks queued...

CodeownerBot: CI: ✅ all checks passed (build, unit, integration).

Ava: Cool — I updated CODEOWNERS in the PR to add `/runtime/daemon/* @Sam` and added @Devon as a reviewer. Pinged @Ali for the workflow.

Devon: Looked through; no functional changes. Approving now. :+1:

Ali: Workflow tweak looks fine, approved.

Sam: Approved runtime changes.

CodeownerBot: Merge blocked until 2 required reviews satisfied — status: satisfied.

Ava: Merged. Thanks everyone — apologies for the multi-owner dance. Notes: we'll follow up with a small docs blurb about moving packages and CODEOWNERS behavior. :white_check_mark:
